shortDescription.default: Beautiful, feature-rich forms for SharePoint lists

longDescription.default: Smart Forms replaces the out-of-the-box SharePoint list form with a modern, designer-built form experience: 24 question types, sections, multi-step wizard mode, conditional logic, validation, automatic column provisioning, response editing and approval, version history, 30 languages, and rich response views for list owners.
